title: 침묵이 흐른다
sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a male baritone vocal. staccato strings, piano arpeggios. staccato strings, taiko drums enter. The production is intimate and dry, emphasizing the natural timbre of the nylon strings and the singer's breathy articulation. strings enter softly. A soft, muffled kick drum enters on beats 1 and 3, accompanied by a subtle shaker on eighth notes. A female vocalist performs with a clear, melodic delivery. The piece transitions into a legato section where the violins take over the melody with lush, sustained phrasing while the woodwinds provide trills and flourishes. The arrangement is sparse and intimate, maintaining a consistent mid-tempo groove.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
거야 눈물이 기억하는 거실에서 목소리를 높였어
네가 옳다고 내가 틀렸다고 서로 한 발짝도 안 물러서
방문 닫고 나가버린 뒤에 후회가 밀려와

[Chorus]

침묵이 흐른다
침묵이 우리를 더 채운다

[Verse 2]
담요를 덮고 눈을 감으면
떠나온 곳이 꿈처럼 멀어져
좌석벨트가 허리를 누르는 게
현실로 돌아가는 신호 같아

[Chorus]
우린 아무것도 사람이 기억하고
시간을 맞추는 것도 벅차고
사랑이라고 말해야 할 때
침묵이 흐른다
침묵이 우리를 더 채운다

[Bridge]
침묵 속의 소리
소음 속의 고요함
둘 다 나를 감싼다
언젠가는 이 소리들을
그리워하게 될 날이 올까
그러면 나는 여기 없을까

[Verse 3]
시간이 기억이
그 이렇게 남아
사라지지 않아
눈 안에

[Outro]
[strings fade to pianissimo, final piano chord]
[piano melody fills]

title: 혼자

The arrangement builds with a lush string section providing legato pads and a melodic bass guitar that follows the chord roots with occasional melodic passing tones. A legato string section provides harmonic support with sustained pads. High-frequency synth pads provide harmonic texture while a clean, rhythmic electric guitar plays muted staccato chords on the off-beats. Electric bass enters with melodic, legato lines. shaker enters. The vocals are delivered in a low-register, intimate, spoken-word style that transitions into melodic singing. final staccato chord from the full band. Uplifting Trance at 138 BPM in F Major.

title: 기쁨
sp: Bossa Nova. slap bass and clean electric guitar scratches. Clean electric guitar funk-style scratches appear in the background. Features a prominent slap bass line, syncopated electric guitar scratches, and bright brass stabs. clean electric guitar scratches, melodic bass guitar enters. clarinet solo with heavy vibrato and glissandos. shaker enters with steady sixteenth notes. The vocal delivery is intimate and breathy, utilizing a mix of chest voice and light head voice. full band arrangement.
lyrics:

(natural, intimate)
The waiter nods, he knows my face

title: 기억
sp: K-Indie folk ballad featuring fingerstyle acoustic guitar and soft male vocals. percussive synth stabs. staccato synth stabs. High-frequency synth stabs and percussive woodblock-style hits provide rhythmic accents. A sub-bass synth provides low-end weight, while the percussion consists of a crisp electronic snare on the backbeat and a tight kick drum. A cinematic percussion ensemble includes taiko drums, orchestral snares, and metallic hits. unison male and female vocals, full band energy. The production is dry and transparent, focusing on the natural timbre of the acoustic instruments. The key is G Major.

title: 거짓말
sp: K-Indie folk pop. Occasional electric piano chords provide harmonic layering during transitions. Rhodes piano layers provide harmonic warmth during transitions. warm acoustic piano chords. Subtle electric piano chords provide harmonic depth in the background. crash cymbal accents. A baritone male vocal delivers a smooth, legato melody in the lower register, transitioning to a breathy head voice in higher passages. The arrangement features a sudden dynamic shift from a relatively sparse verse to a dense, wall-of-sound chorus. Tempo is 105 BPM in the key of G Major.
